definition: Source endpoint IP address.
audit_notes: Identifier-like; generally unsuitable for cross-dataset semantic mapping.

definition: Source transport-layer port number.
audit_notes: Potentially comparable to a source-port field only if the target dataset retains it.

definition: Destination endpoint IP address.
audit_notes: Identifier-like; generally unsuitable for cross-dataset semantic mapping.

definition: Destination transport-layer port number.
audit_notes: CICIDS2017 contains Destination Port; semantics are directly comparable.

definition: Protocol used by the transaction, such as TCP or UDP.
audit_notes: Comparable only if CICIDS protocol is retained by the project dataset.

definition: Connection state reported for the flow/transaction.
audit_notes: Extractor-specific state vocabulary; do not map by name alone.

definition: Elapsed duration of the network record/flow.
audit_notes: Strong candidate for CICIDS Flow Duration after unit normalization.

definition: Total bytes transferred from source to destination.
audit_notes: Strong candidate for CICIDS Total Length of Fwd Packets.

definition: Total bytes transferred from destination to source.
audit_notes: Strong candidate for CICIDS Total Length of Bwd Packets.

definition: Source-to-destination IP time-to-live value associated with the flow.
audit_notes: No obvious CICIDS2017 flow-feature equivalent.

definition: Destination-to-source IP time-to-live value associated with the flow.
audit_notes: No obvious CICIDS2017 flow-feature equivalent.

definition: Count of source-side packets reported as retransmitted or dropped.
audit_notes: CICIDS flag/count features are not equivalent to packet loss.

definition: Count of destination-side packets reported as retransmitted or dropped.
audit_notes: No direct CICIDS2017 equivalent.

definition: Detected application service, such as HTTP, FTP, SSH, or DNS.
audit_notes: Extractor/application-classification dependent.

definition: Source-to-destination traffic load expressed as bits per second.
audit_notes: Conceptually related to byte rate but unit/calculation must be checked before mapping.

definition: Destination-to-source traffic load expressed as bits per second.
audit_notes: Conceptually related to backward byte rate; CICIDS lacks a direct named backward bytes/s feature.

definition: Number of packets sent from source to destination.
audit_notes: Strong candidate for CICIDS Total Fwd Packets.

definition: Number of packets sent from destination to source.
audit_notes: Strong candidate for CICIDS Total Backward Packets.

definition: Source TCP window advertisement value.
audit_notes: Related to CICIDS FWD Init Win Bytes, but computation/which packet is sampled must be verified.

definition: Destination TCP window advertisement value.
audit_notes: Related to CICIDS Bwd Init Win Bytes, but strict equivalence requires extractor verification.

definition: Source TCP base sequence number.
audit_notes: No direct CICIDS2017 equivalent.

definition: Destination TCP base sequence number.
audit_notes: No direct CICIDS2017 equivalent.

definition: Mean packet size for packets transmitted by the source.
audit_notes: Strong candidate for CICIDS Fwd Packet Length Mean, subject to packet-size definition.

definition: Mean packet size for packets transmitted by the destination.
audit_notes: Strong candidate for CICIDS Bwd Packet Length Mean, subject to packet-size definition.

definition: HTTP request/response pipeline depth observed in the connection.
audit_notes: HTTP-specific; no clear CICIDS2017 counterpart.

definition: Uncompressed content size transferred in the HTTP response body.
audit_notes: HTTP-specific; not equivalent to generic backward byte count.

definition: Source-direction packet timing jitter.
audit_notes: Candidate for CICIDS Fwd IAT Std only as conditional mapping until formula equivalence is verified.

definition: Destination-direction packet timing jitter.
audit_notes: Candidate for CICIDS Bwd IAT Std only as conditional mapping until formula equivalence is verified.

definition: Start timestamp of the network record.
audit_notes: Absolute time; not appropriate for direct semantic mapping to flow statistics.

definition: End/last timestamp of the network record.
audit_notes: Absolute time; can derive duration but should not be mapped to a duration feature directly.

definition: Source-direction inter-packet arrival time measure.
audit_notes: Current repo maps to CICIDS Fwd IAT Mean; verify exact aggregation formula.

definition: Destination-direction inter-packet arrival time measure.
audit_notes: Current repo maps to CICIDS Bwd IAT Mean; verify exact aggregation formula.

definition: TCP connection setup round-trip measure defined as synack + ackdat.
audit_notes: Handshake-specific; not the same as generic flow IAT.

definition: Time from SYN to SYN-ACK during TCP connection setup.
audit_notes: No direct CICIDS2017 feature.

definition: Time from SYN-ACK to ACK during TCP connection setup.
audit_notes: No direct CICIDS2017 feature.

definition: Indicator for flows whose source and destination IPs and ports are the same.
audit_notes: Dataset-specific engineered feature.

definition: Count associated with connection state and source/destination TTL combinations.
audit_notes: Historical/context feature; no direct CICIDS counterpart.

definition: Count of HTTP-method observations associated with the flow context.
audit_notes: HTTP-specific contextual feature.

definition: Indicator/count describing whether an FTP login was observed/successful.
audit_notes: Dataset values can require cleaning; not a CICIDS flow statistic.

definition: Number of FTP commands associated with the flow/context.
audit_notes: Raw files may encode this field inconsistently; coerce carefully.

definition: Count of recent connections sharing the same service and source address.
audit_notes: Historical/contextual, not a single-flow physical measurement.

definition: Count of recent connections sharing the same service and destination address.
audit_notes: Historical/contextual feature.

definition: Count of recent connections to the same destination address.
audit_notes: Historical/contextual feature.

definition: Count of recent connections from the same source address.
audit_notes: Historical/contextual feature.

definition: Count of recent connections from the same source to the same destination port.
audit_notes: Historical/contextual feature.

definition: Count of recent connections to the same destination from the same source port.
audit_notes: Historical/contextual feature.

definition: Count of recent connections involving the same source-destination address pair.
audit_notes: Historical/contextual feature.

definition: Attack family/category assigned to the record, or normal traffic.
audit_notes: Target variable; never use as an input feature for binary NIDS.

definition: Binary ground-truth label: normal versus attack.
audit_notes: Evaluation/training label; exclude from feature mapping inputs.
